next_steps: Step 1: Install the Judge.me app from the Shopify app store and connect your store to the app.
Step 2: Set up the automated review collection sequence by configuring the email or SMS triggers and review request templates.
Step 3: Test the review collection sequence by sending a test review request to a customer and verifying that it is delivered correctly.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Lucy & Yak can leverage Judge.me's lightweight and budget-friendly approach to automate review collection, which aligns with their moderate budget and Shopify setup.
Trustpilot's independent review platform and low setup complexity make it a suitable choice for Lucy & Yak, who can benefit from its trust-signal-focused approach to review collection.

Although Yotpo offers a full-featured reviews and loyalty platform, its medium setup complexity and lack of free tier may make it less suitable for Lucy & Yak, who are looking for a more streamlined solution.
